authority: TopHat-1.0-Definition Review 4, Section 8; consumer-independent acceptance clarification

criteria.requirement: A Svelte or SvelteKit workspace retains the current strict Svelte 5 behavior where it applies.

tests.name: Svelte guard enforces only Svelte profiles and makes non-applicability visible
registered Svelte hook executes on stdin/stdout with a real host config

criteria.requirement: A React or Next.js workspace can operate without receiving Svelte instructions or Svelte validation failures.

tests.name: Svelte guard enforces only Svelte profiles and makes non-applicability visible
all eight workspace profiles select matching framework and smoke boundaries
incompatible task skills, framework instructions, and undeclared optional tools deny

criteria.requirement: Next.js server and client boundaries are represented correctly in generated tasks and reviews.

tests.name: Svelte guard enforces only Svelte profiles and makes non-applicability visible
Next.js server, client, route, and action task samples carry distinct boundaries

criteria.requirement: A Node.js backend workspace can operate without browser UI or Playwright assumptions unless the project declares such a need.

tests.name: Svelte guard enforces only Svelte profiles and makes non-applicability visible
all eight workspace profiles select matching framework and smoke boundaries

criteria.requirement: An Electron workspace retains explicit main, renderer, preload, IPC, and desktop security boundaries.

tests.name: Svelte guard enforces only Svelte profiles and makes non-applicability visible
Electron main, preload, renderer, and IPC samples retain process boundaries

criteria.requirement: Every supported project executes deterministic validation through declared pnpm commands, including applicable unit, integration, type, lint, build, smoke, coverage, and end-to-end validation.

tests.name: gate order, appended categories, precommit SHA, and explicit optional skip
preflight refuses absent scripts without running earlier categories
missing pnpm, failed coverage, and tracked mutation deny truthfully

criteria.requirement: A project may use Vitest or an explicitly declared Node-compatible test runner while preserving the required TDD behavior.

tests.name: gate order, appended categories, precommit SHA, and explicit optional skip
actual Node coverage enforces host-owned passing and failing thresholds through pnpm
both actual runners reproduce red then green without changing the shared executor

criteria.requirement: Standard and critical execution routes remain separate and deterministic.

tests.name: fixed junior/mid/senior routes and mixed highest tier

criteria.requirement: Security review is activated by critical classification rather than applied indiscriminately.

tests.name: fixed junior/mid/senior routes and mixed highest tier

criteria.requirement: QA is conditionally required through deterministic classification of observable user-facing changes and uses only the validation methods appropriate to the task.

tests.name: fixed junior/mid/senior routes and mixed highest tier
backend internal work skips UI QA with an explicit reason

criteria.requirement: Incompatible framework instructions cannot accidentally govern the same workspace or task.

tests.name: missing file and malformed JSON deny structurally
missing, unknown, and incompatible workspace data deny
invalid paths and private targets deny

criteria.requirement: A supported host project can be initialized from its approved contract and receive valid, bounded, traceable implementation tasks.

tests.name: task mechanically traces all four source kinds and exact extracts

criteria.requirement: TopHat validates the active documentation package before creating its private roadmap or implementation tasks.

tests.name: draft success never permits planning; approved package has exact authoritative hashes
changed authority bytes report expected/calculated hashes without any repair
missing/invalid authority hashes and proposed active decisions block approved mode
inactive retained authoritative bytes are also hashed
missing files, directory instead of file, and package outside docs deny

criteria.requirement: Generated tasks trace back to authoritative requirements, decisions, contracts, and acceptance criteria.

tests.name: task mechanically traces all four source kinds and exact extracts

criteria.requirement: Public project documentation remains usable without TopHat while private orchestration state remains separate.

tests.name: all scoped planning workflows declare fresh approved package validation before side effects

criteria.requirement: Implementation and review workflows evaluate understandability, responsibility boundaries, change locality, and behavioral tests without enforcing arbitrary code-size metrics or authorizing unrelated refactoring.

tests.name: every task creation/amendment route requires the same classifier
developer and review roles share the semantic clean-code contract

criteria.requirement: QA approval is bound to the exact tested commit, and subsequent product-code changes invalidate that approval.

tests.name: complete current web evidence permits publication; helpers do not mutate
product and private-state-only commits both invalidate commit A
later failed attempt prevents old approval and forged index fallback

criteria.requirement: Each QA verdict maps the applicable acceptance criteria to reproducible evidence, including the relevant environment, journeys, states, and results.

tests.name: complete current web evidence permits publication; helpers do not mutate
all three QA verdicts align with evidence and only approval publishes
missing, duplicate, foreign and method-unmapped criterion evidence denies

criteria.requirement: The QA agent does not implement product-code fixes or approve its own remediation.

tests.name: PM advisory session accepts existing dirty/failing evidence without mutation
bounded QA runner CLI suppresses automatic pnpm setup and rejects unknown flags
QA preflight detached HEAD, conflict, unsafe output and unavailable Git deny
new attempt cannot approve unchanged code after failed QA; refreshed candidate can

criteria.requirement: Every TopHat boundary is identified honestly as either deterministic enforcement or instructed agent behavior. Configured deterministic gates fail closed on malformed input or execution failure, while inapplicable optional gates skip explicitly and visibly.

tests.name: protected writes fail closed on malformed payloads

criteria.requirement: Git-mutating workflows verify the expected branch and clean working-tree state before mutation, halt visibly on detached HEAD, unexpected conflicts, or command failure, and do not perform destructive recovery without explicit human authorization.

tests.name: clean branch creation and explicit resume verify resulting branch identity
staged-only change with reverted worktree remains dirty
detached and unborn HEAD deny visibly
submodule drift is denied even with ignore=all
ordinary profile denies merge conflict; nominated exception binds all index entries
authorized conflict edits preserve incoming staged files and commit both parents

criteria.requirement: Roadmaps, workflows, templates, and state consistently use Development Phase for major roadmap segments and Workflow Stage for operational state; the term Epic is removed from the TopHat work hierarchy.

tests.name: active templates and instructions have no Epic tier or numbered operational Phase

criteria.requirement: A project with incomplete input may use the optional Project Definition Stage to produce a reviewed draft package, but workspace initialization accepts it only after explicit human approval and deterministic package validation.

tests.name: incomplete input remains blocked until review questions resolve and matching human evidence follows
missing approval and out-of-package evidence deny; retained prior version can be reapproved only with a new version

criteria.requirement: TopHat can attach to an existing supported project through read-only discovery, workspace and documentation validation, baseline validation assessment, and explicit human approval before private orchestration state is generated.

tests.name: read-only discovery resolves a candidate config without installing it and real CLI denies no proposal
readiness refuses missing approval, stale source/script body, spoofed state and mixed hook
workflow instructions keep discovery, command permission, final approval and manual removal separate
real assessment/readiness CLIs accept stdin records and write nothing before approval application

criteria.requirement: A failing existing-project validation baseline halts attachment with a visible report and does not trigger silent gate weakening, broad remediation, or invented scoped-validation behavior.

tests.name: authorization denial and absent script cannot run baseline commands
pre-existing failing validation halts; records stderr and no automated policy weakening

criteria.requirement: TopHat documents tracked/shared and local/private installation considerations and provides a safe manual detachment procedure without requiring the TopHat CLI or changing host-product history.

tests.name: exact manual removal retains product, approved docs, package scripts, history and host exclusions
mixed ownership, product paths and stale current hashes cannot become removal permission
drifted hook and redirected hook config are preserved and denied
partial manual application invalidates instead of claiming atomic multi-file publication

criteria.requirement: Derived host-project documentation is evaluated at the end of every Development Phase and verified again at project completion; the workflow may explicitly record that no change is required.

tests.name: phase documentation changes and no-change both require reviewed exact acceptance
immediate task sync cannot accept a Development Phase
immediate metadata is closed, justified and fingerprinted
final verification requires accepted phase history and complete handoff coverage
immediate receipts cannot substitute for phase acceptance

criteria.requirement: The technical-writing responsibility can modify only declared derived-documentation targets, cannot silently change authoritative requirements or product behavior, and halts on conflicts between authority and realized implementation.

tests.name: phase documentation changes and no-change both require reviewed exact acceptance
protected targets and broad parents cannot grant authority/product/private writes
writer product/private/untracked/index/Git mutation is rejected after failure
fresh compatible document claim QA binds exact candidate, methods and writer independence
static SVG and binary document assets retain exact bytes and mandatory active-content review
workflow contracts enforce phase boundary, no autonomous README, no writer commands or merge

criteria.requirement: The Project Manager and Sprint Briefing workflow remain advisory and read-only, with deterministic mutation blocking only when the host supplies a verified workflow identity and honest instructed-boundary classification otherwise.

tests.name: PM advisory session accepts existing dirty/failing evidence without mutation
bounded QA runner CLI suppresses automatic pnpm setup and rejects unknown flags
PM private/product/index writes and unknown operation categories deny

criteria.requirement: Projects may declare a runner-neutral coverage validation category and their own thresholds without TopHat imposing a universal percentage, requiring Vitest, or creating a duplicate coverage-specific interception system.

tests.name: gate order, appended categories, precommit SHA, and explicit optional skip
actual Node coverage enforces host-owned passing and failing thresholds through pnpm
actual Vitest V8 coverage enforces different host policies through the same pnpm runner
missing pnpm, failed coverage, and tracked mutation deny truthfully
different host-owned coverage thresholds drive only the declared pnpm script result
